messages.message:
Interim CEO was kept in the dark over Huang’s return
 
Colette Kress 

Nvidia’s interim chief executive and other senior management were unaware of discussions over the weekend to reinstate Jensen Huang, according to two people familiar with the situation.

Colette Kress, a 13-year veteran of Nvidia and its chief financial officer, served just 11 days as interim chief executive. At a company-wide meeting last week, she sought to lift staff morale by accelerating pay and equity increases amid concerns of a brain drain in the aftermath of Huang’s departure.

She had emphasised the need to “move forward” without Huang.

Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
😂
